rejected_candidates.title: No withdrawal function — tokens permanently locked in the contract
rejected_candidates.reason: Not reliably true as a security issue in this design scope; locked-recovery behavior may be intentional, and owner can already redirect AAVE via pool-allowance control. More of design/governance policy than exploitable vulnerability.

rejected_candidates.title: Owner can set malicious pool to drain all AAVE via infinite allowance
rejected_candidates.reason: Privileged-owner trust assumption, not a permissionless exploit. This is expected capability of `onlyOwner` and overlaps with governance risk rather than a standalone vulnerability.

rejected_candidates.title: Unrestricted asset parameter allows draining any token held by the contract
rejected_candidates.reason: Contract only approves AAVE to pool; draining arbitrary tokens via `pool.deposit(asset,...)` is not generally feasible without corresponding allowance/funding and is unsupported by current code.

rejected_candidates.title: Potential re-entrancy through pool.deposit call after AAVE transfer
rejected_candidates.reason: No exploitable mutable state dependency was identified; claimed amplification is unnecessary because repeated direct calls already achieve reward draining.

rejected_candidates.title: Missing events for all state-changing functions
rejected_candidates.reason: Observability issue only; no direct protocol-level fund-loss/theft/insolvency/DoS impact.

rejected_candidates.title: No zero-address validation for recipient and asset in proxyDeposit
rejected_candidates.reason: Primarily caller-self-harm/input-sanity concern; no clear permissionless protocol exploit established from current code alone.

rejected_candidates.title: REWARD uses uint128 but allowance and deposits operate on uint256
rejected_candidates.reason: Type-width difference is intentional/benign under checked arithmetic and does not create a concrete exploit path.

rejected_candidates.title: Pool address can be set to non-contract/zero, enabling user-fund capture without real deposit
rejected_candidates.reason: The specific fund-capture claim is overstated for Solidity 0.8.4 high-level external calls (invalid target reverts). Retained a downgraded misconfiguration-DoS variant instead.

rejected_candidates.title: setPool does not validate that newReward_ is non-zero
rejected_candidates.reason: `REWARD=0` is a parameter choice, not inherently exploitable; economic undesirability alone is governance/configuration policy, not a standalone vulnerability.
